rows.Kwic: 取善捨惡，觀空入定，即屬造作。更若向外馳求，轉疎轉遠。
rows.sourceTitle: 馬祖道一禪師廣錄（四家語錄卷一）

Override.AttributionNote: Extensive Record of Mazu Daoyi (馬祖道一禪師廣錄（四家語錄卷一）): in his extensive record, Mazu Daoyi says choosing good and rejecting evil, observing emptiness and entering concentration, are contrivance.
